answer: The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in violet, expire in whisper, and dawn lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 138 aliases therefore needs 146 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2357 identities would post 3033 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
